title: Network Management: Main Exam, 15 January 2021
department: Department of Information Technology / enterprise Computing
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Define the following terms.
Protocol
Network
Physical topology
Logical topology
Differentiate between a public and a private IP address.
State and explain 3 network troubleshooting commands.
Describe the following network devices and what they do.
Switch
Gateway
Repeater
What is network management? Why do networks need to be managed?
Briefly describe the five classes of network address, giving examples in each case.
Explain why it is necessary for an organization to have a network security policy.
Why is it important to quantify risk before developing mitigating mechanisms?
Using a well-labelled diagram, differentiate between TCP/IP and OSI protocols and give the benefits of each.
Describe three security compromises that can be performed on data.
Explain why it is important for organizations to sign service level agreements (SLAs) with vendors.
Describe the structure of an IP address.
Describe the five functional areas of network management.
Describe the process of gathering user requirements for a small network.
Differentiate between static IP addressing and dynamic IP addressing.
State the role of the network operating system (NOS) in a network. What factors will you consider before choosing a network operating system?
Describe the following techniques of procuring network resources.
Outsourcing network services
Leasing network equipment
Buying from a vendor and installing on your own
